methodology: Full filesystem scan + database schema analysis + source code audit

database.key_finding: Every table has project_id foreign key. Zero cross-project foreign keys exist.

file_storage.key_finding: Each project directory contains only its own files. No shared directories.

object_storage_mock.key_finding: Every file encodes its project_id in the filename. Impossible to read cross-project without explicit lookup.

output_storage.key_finding: Single-project output directory. No cross-project data.

evidence_archive.key_finding: Each evidence folder is mission-scoped. No cross-project evidence references found.

mission_outputs.key_finding: Mission outputs are spec documents, not project data.

vector_stores.key_finding: ZERO vector stores, embedding databases, or similarity indexes exist anywhere in the project.

caches.key_finding: Only Python bytecode caches and pytest cache exist. Neither stores project data.

memory_files.key_finding: No memory files, no session state files, no shared state between projects.
